title: CHGR shared digest definitions
description: Layer 2 shape-only digest definitions for the Canonical Human Governance Record (CHGR) schema family (Phase 143E, CHGR-001 v1.0 Sec.10, Sec.21). A well-formed digest string proves nothing about whether it matches any actual artifact's recomputed bytes -- shape only. Recomputation and comparison is a governance/verification.py responsibility (pcae governance-record verify), never a Layer 2 responsibility. Deliberately independent of src/pcae/schema_resources/cltr_cutover/shared/digest.schema.json: CHGR-001 Sec.16/Sec.19.1 requires CHGR remain a wholly separate artifact family, never composed, subclassed, or wrapped from the Typed Authority Model's schema family.

sha256_hex.description: Bare 64-character lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest. No 'sha256:' prefix. Always present when the owning field is present.

record_digest.description: The digest of the owning CHGR artifact's own canonical payload. Shape-checked only; never recomputed at Layer 2. A matching digest proves byte-for-byte correspondence with the payload at the time the digest was computed -- it never proves authority (CHGR-REQ-093).

referenced_record_digest.description: The digest of a CHGR-family artifact referenced by another CHGR-family artifact (e.g. a HumanGovernanceRecord's confirmation_evidence_ref). Shape-checked only; whether it actually matches the referenced artifact is a verification-layer responsibility (pcae governance-record verify), not a schema responsibility.
